offences.quote: Unauthorised AI use in formal assessments may be considered as academic misconduct, depending on its use and advantage.
Uploading confidential or personal data without approval
AI must not be used in ways that misrepresent competence or authenticity.

process.quote: The appropriate route for investigation will depend on the nature and context of the suspected misuse.

definitions.quote: For the purposes of this policy, AI refers to systems that generate new outputs in formats such as text, images, audio, or video.
